title: FEIN FEIN FEIN
blurb: Rave energy compressed into one repeated syllable, taken from Travis Scott's track on Utopia and immediately weaponised by the internet. The song is built on repetition to the point of hypnosis, so it made ideal raw material: edits use the chant as a pure intensity dial, cranking it up wherever a video needs to peak. It has been genuinely useful for gym content and genuinely unbearable at close range, both of which appear to be intentional. Deploy it when a moment requires more aggression than the situation strictly justifies.
origin: From Travis Scott's 'FE!N', adopted as an all-purpose hype chant.
